rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise LMS-031 exception if p_window_days is NULL or outside range 1 to 90 inclusive.

rules.title: Initialize counters
rules.statement: Set p_posted and p_skipped to 0 before processing.

rules.title: Skip NPA loans
rules.statement: If asset_class equals 'NPA' then increment p_skipped and skip the loan.

rules.title: Require benchmark code
rules.statement: Raise LMS-005 exception if benchmark_code is NULL for a floating loan.

rules.title: Compute next reset date
rules.statement: Calculate months since disb_date, round down to multiple of reset_months then add one reset_months interval to obtain v_next.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age); no handling shown for reset_months <= 0.

rules.title: Window filter on reset date
rules.statement: Skip loan if v_next is after p_as_of plus p_window_days.

rules.title: Notice date weekday adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else unchanged.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= v_next plus spread_pct; both values coalesce to 0 if absent.
rules.notes: numeric type, no scale declared; ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old equals most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= prior cycle start date plus spread_pct; both values coalesce to 0 if absent.

rules.title: Skip small rate change or duplicate notice
rules.statement: If absolute difference between v_new and v_old is less than 0.25 or a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with matching note pattern then increment p_skipped and skip.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE with partial date string; no rounding call shown.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice and note containing old and new rates.

open_questions: Confirm that missing benchmark rates are intended to be treated as 0.
Confirm that duplicate notice detection relies on a LIKE pattern containing only the date portion.
Is the rounding behavior of the v_months calculation (integer division) the intended reset-cycle logic?
Confirm handling when reset_months is zero or negative.
